documentation.content: The service-wide daily cap on reports (`config/runtime.reports.perDay`) refused its first report of the UTC day (`report_day_limit`: `day`, `perDay`, `reports`; once a day, `stats/{day}.reportCapReachedAt`). Someone may be flooding reports, or the cap is too low. Read `reports/` in the Firestore console. See functions/README.md, "Reports" and "Alerts".
